name: Default
shortDescription: Observability platform for logs, traces, metrics and session replays, with the ClickStack UI, an OpenTelemetry collector, ClickHouse and MongoDB.

alerts.message: Sign up right after the deploy: the first account owns the team, registration then closes, and until it exists the collector discards incoming data. Send OpenTelemetry data over OTLP/HTTP to https://<domain> (paths under /v1) with the ingestion key from Team Settings > API Keys in the authorization header; the gRPC port 4317 is not published.
